patch_description: The recommendation suggests interleaving a full pairwise-swap sweep with the insertion-based local search. Insertion moves (relocating a transaction to a different position) and adjacent/arbitrary swap moves (exchanging two transactions' positions) explore different neighborhoods of the schedule space; combining them within the proven restart/time-budget structure covers both move classes. Step-by-step reasoning: (1) the greedy construction gives a decent starting schedule; (2) insertion sweeps already improve it; (3) some local optima of the insertion neighborhood can only be escaped by swap moves (and vice versa), so alternating sweeps within each local search round converges to better minima; (4) the cost cache via get_opt_seq_cost ensures the same safe API is used, no new API risk. We modify local_search_insertion to perform one insertion pass followed by one full pairwise-swap pass per round, keeping the existing 20-restart/100-second outer structure intact.
